title: 第1607章 他怎么敢第1606章 传讯铜镜
content_zh:
二狗子接过两面镜子，问清了具体的用法之后，就离开了地下空间。
这种镜子传讯类的法宝，修仙界本来就有。
只是使用范围照样有些限制，有时候会受到周围灵气波动、神识或法力的干扰。
普遍效果都不太好，因此，应用范围并不广。
这次张三他们炼制的铜镜，对原来的技术，做了一些改进和提升。
二狗子出来之后，就和墨羽一人拿一块。
墨羽拿着她手里的铜镜飞走了。
小半天后，二狗子手里的铜镜亮起，里面浮现出墨羽的身影。
“岛主，我现在距离你一万里，能听清楚吗？”
二狗子点点头，“能听清楚。”
“好的，我再换个地方。”
又过了一阵，镜子再次亮起。
“岛主，我此刻在三万里之外……”
距离又远了三倍，看到镜子里的人，已经没有原来那么清晰。
双方之间说话的声音，也稍微有些模糊，但用于传递信息，还是勉强可以用的。
接下来墨羽又在五万里外，与二狗子联系。
这一次她站在一座小岛上与二狗子通话，背景已经模模糊糊，声音也不太听得清楚，断断续续。
“岛主……还能听到吗……”
“不好……仙君府修士来了……他们又打起来了”
随着一声惊呼，二狗子看到模糊的画面中，有两名修士祭出法宝飞到空中。

“岛……我听……到了……”
因为附近有人斗法，在法力波动的干扰下，墨羽的声音变得模糊不清。
二狗子看出，她急于想说什么，但这边却听不清楚。
这时，战场飞出一个小黑点，刚开始看还是小黑点，然后越来越大，原来是一只竹篮子……
“咔嚓……”
一声轻响，他面前的铜镜裂成了两半，画面全都消失了。
“墨羽……”
二狗子大吼一声，却也只是徒劳。
两人之间隔了五万里，法宝破碎，双方已经无法通讯联系。
二狗子担心墨羽的安危，当即手一挥，大白鹅出现在面前。
“嘎咯……”
“大鹅，带我去找人！”
二狗子说着，已经跳上大鹅的背。
大白鹅翅膀一展，就已经化为一道白虹，飞了出去。
这一路，大白鹅飞出了最快的速度，只用了一个多时辰，终于看到前方有人斗法的动静。
二狗子刚一靠近，就有一柄飞剑，不问青红皂白地向他劈来。
他抽出背后的巨剑，用力一斩，就已经把那柄飞剑挡住。
content_en:
Ergouzi took the two mirrors, asked about their specific usage, and left the underground space.
This kind of mirror communication magic weapon already exists in the world of immortality.
However, the range of use is still somewhat limited, and may sometimes be interfered by surrounding spiritual energy fluctuations, spiritual consciousness or mana.
The general effect is not very good, therefore, the application range is not wide.
This time, the bronze mirror that Zhang San and the others refined made some improvements and upgrades to the original technology.
After Er Gouzi came out, he and Mo Yu took one piece each.
Mo Yu took the bronze mirror in her hand and flew away.
A little while later, the bronze mirror in Er Gouzi's hand lit up, and Mo Yu's figure appeared in it.
"Island Master, I am ten thousand miles away from you now, can you hear me clearly?"
Ergouzi nodded, "I can hear you clearly."
"Okay, I'll change places."
After a while, the mirror lit up again.
"Island Master, I am thirty thousand miles away at the moment..."
The distance has grown three times further, and the person in the mirror is no longer as clear as before.
The voices spoken between the two parties were slightly blurry, but they were still barely usable for conveying information.
Next, Mo Yu contacted Er Gouzi fifty thousand miles away.
This time she stood on a small island and talked to Ergouzi. The background was blurry and the voice was not clear and intermittent.
"Island owner... can you still hear me..."
"No...the monks from the Immortal Lord Mansion are here...they started fighting again"
With an exclamation, Ergouzi saw two monks flying into the air with their magic weapons in the blurry picture.
"Island...I heard...arrived..."
Because there were people fighting nearby, Mo Yu's voice became indistinct under the interference of mana fluctuations.
Er Gouzi saw that she was eager to say something, but could not hear clearly.
At this time, a small black dot flew out of the battlefield. At first it looked like a small black dot, but then it got bigger and bigger. It turned out to be a bamboo basket...
"Click..."
With a soft sound, the bronze mirror in front of him broke into two halves, and all the images disappeared.
"Mo Yu..."
Ergouzi roared, but it was all in vain.
Fifty thousand miles separated the two, the magic weapon was broken, and the two sides were no longer able to communicate.
Er Gouzi was worried about Mo Yu's safety, and immediately waved his hand, and the big white goose appeared in front of him.
"Quack..."
"Big Goose, take me to find someone!"
Ergouzi said as he jumped on the goose's back.
As soon as the big white goose spread its wings, it turned into a white rainbow and flew out.
Along the way, the big white goose flew at its fastest speed. It only took more than an hour to finally see the sound of someone fighting in the front.
As soon as Er Gouzi got close, a flying sword struck at him indiscriminately.
He drew out the giant sword from behind and slashed hard, blocking the flying sword.
